test_law.standard: Measure retained closure plus novel conversational transfer without adding words outside the frozen 350.

describe buying, selling, cost, and price
name government as a civic system
describe police, hospital, and library as public services
state that something belongs to someone
describe a rule or law in plain language
repair a social conflict using forgive/settle/calm

marginal_gain.note: The overall percentage moves only slightly because the test frontier was expanded. The important gain is that all prior gaps remain closed while 17 of 20 new functions transfer.

interpretation: The 350-word system preserves all previously demonstrated capabilities.
Band B generalizes beyond its three source failures into civic, economic, conflict-repair, and ownership language.
The new frontier has shifted away from structural/institutional gaps toward ordinary world-detail gaps.
This is a healthy progression signal: the architecture is broadening rather than repeatedly reopening old failures.
